16 // AXI4-Lite Multiplexer: This module multiplexes the AXI4-Lite slave ports down to one master port.
17 //                        The multiplexing happens in a round robin fashion, responses get
18 //                        sent back in order.
19 
20 // register macros
21 `include "common_cells/registers.svh"
22 
23 module axi_lite_mux #(
24   // AXI4-Lite parameter and channel types
25   parameter type          aw_chan_t  = logic, // AW LITE Channel Type
26   parameter type           w_chan_t  = logic, //  W LITE Channel Type
27   parameter type           b_chan_t  = logic, //  B LITE Channel Type
28   parameter type          ar_chan_t  = logic, // AR LITE Channel Type
29   parameter type           r_chan_t  = logic, //  R LITE Channel Type
30   parameter type          axi_req_t  = logic, // AXI4-Lite request type
31   parameter type         axi_resp_t  = logic, // AXI4-Lite response type
32   parameter int unsigned NoSlvPorts  = 32'd0, // Number of slave ports
33   // Maximum number of outstanding transactions per write or read
34   parameter int unsigned MaxTrans    = 32'd0,
35   // If enabled, this multiplexer is purely combinatorial
36   parameter bit          FallThrough = 1'b0,
37   // add spill register on write master port, adds a cycle latency on write channels
38   parameter bit          SpillAw     = 1'b1,
39   parameter bit          SpillW      = 1'b0,
40   parameter bit          SpillB      = 1'b0,
41   // add spill register on read master port, adds a cycle latency on read channels
42   parameter bit          SpillAr     = 1'b1,
43   parameter bit          SpillR      = 1'b0
44 ) (
45   input  logic                       clk_i,    // Clock
46   input  logic                       rst_ni,   // Asynchronous reset active low
47   input  logic                       test_i,   // Test Mode enable
48   // slave ports (AXI4-Lite inputs), connect master modules here
49   input  axi_req_t  [NoSlvPorts-1:0] slv_reqs_i,
50   output axi_resp_t [NoSlvPorts-1:0] slv_resps_o,
51   // master port (AXI4-Lite output), connect slave module here
52   output axi_req_t                   mst_req_o,
53   input  axi_resp_t                  mst_resp_i
54 );
55   // pass through if only one slave port
56   if (NoSlvPorts == 32'h1) begin : gen_no_mux
57     assign mst_req_o = slv_reqs_i[0];
58     assign slv_resps_o[0] = mst_resp_i;
59   // other non degenerate cases
60   end else begin : gen_mux
61     // typedef for the FIFO types
62     typedef logic [$clog2(NoSlvPorts)-1:0] select_t;
63 
64     // input to the AW arbitration tree, unpacked from request struct
65     aw_chan_t [NoSlvPorts-1:0] slv_aw_chans;
66     logic     [NoSlvPorts-1:0] slv_aw_valids, slv_aw_readies;
67 
68     // AW channel arb tree decision
69     select_t  aw_select;
70     aw_chan_t mst_aw_chan;
71     logic     mst_aw_valid, mst_aw_ready;
72 
73     // AW master handshake internal, so that we are able to stall, if w_fifo is full
74     logic     aw_valid,     aw_ready;
75 
76     // FF to lock the AW valid signal, when a new arbitration decision is made the decision
77     // gets pushed into the W FIFO, when it now stalls prevent subsequent pushing
78     // This FF removes AW to W dependency
79     logic     lock_aw_valid_d, lock_aw_valid_q;
80     logic     load_aw_lock;
81 
82     // signals for the FIFO that holds the last switching decision of the AW channel
83     logic     w_fifo_full,  w_fifo_empty;
84     logic     w_fifo_push,  w_fifo_pop;
85 
86     // W channel spill reg
87     select_t  w_select;
88     w_chan_t  mst_w_chan;
89     logic     mst_w_valid,  mst_w_ready;
90 
91     // switching decision for the B response back routing
92     select_t  b_select;
93     // signals for the FIFO that holds the last switching decision of the AW channel
94     logic     b_fifo_full,  b_fifo_empty;
95     logic     /*w_fifo_pop*/b_fifo_pop;
96 
97     // B channel spill reg
98     b_chan_t  mst_b_chan;
99     logic     mst_b_valid,  mst_b_ready;

110     // AR master handshake internal, so that we are able to stall, if R_fifo is full
111     logic     ar_valid,     ar_ready;
112 
113     // master ID in the r_id
114     select_t  r_select;
115 
116     // signals for the FIFO that holds the last switching decision of the AR channel
117     logic     r_fifo_full,  r_fifo_empty;
118     logic     r_fifo_push,  r_fifo_pop;
119 
120     // R channel spill reg
121     r_chan_t  mst_r_chan;
122     logic     mst_r_valid,  mst_r_ready;
123 
124     //--------------------------------------
125     // AW Channel
126     //--------------------------------------
127     // unpach AW channel from request/response array
128     for (genvar i = 0; i < NoSlvPorts; i++) begin : gen_aw_arb_input
129       assign slv_aw_chans[i]         = slv_reqs_i[i].aw;
130       assign slv_aw_valids[i]        = slv_reqs_i[i].aw_valid;
131       assign slv_resps_o[i].aw_ready = slv_aw_readies[i];
132     end
133     rr_arb_tree #(
134       .NumIn    ( NoSlvPorts ),
135       .DataType ( aw_chan_t  ),
136       .AxiVldRdy( 1'b1       ),
137       .LockIn   ( 1'b1       )
138     ) i_aw_arbiter (
139       .clk_i  ( clk_i          ),
140       .rst_ni ( rst_ni         ),
141       .flush_i( 1'b0           ),
142       .rr_i   ( '0             ),
143       .req_i  ( slv_aw_valids  ),
144       .gnt_o  ( slv_aw_readies ),
145       .data_i ( slv_aw_chans   ),
146       .gnt_i  ( aw_ready       ),
147       .req_o  ( aw_valid       ),
148       .data_o ( mst_aw_chan    ),
149       .idx_o  ( aw_select      )

199       .push_i    ( w_fifo_push  ),
200       .data_o    ( w_select     ),
201       .pop_i     ( w_fifo_pop   )
202     );
203 
204     spill_register #(
205       .T       ( aw_chan_t  ),
206       .Bypass  ( ~SpillAw   ) // Param indicated that we want a spill reg
207     ) i_aw_spill_reg (
208       .clk_i   ( clk_i               ),
209       .rst_ni  ( rst_ni              ),
210       .valid_i ( mst_aw_valid        ),
211       .ready_o ( mst_aw_ready        ),
212       .data_i  ( mst_aw_chan         ),
213       .valid_o ( mst_req_o.aw_valid  ),
214       .ready_i ( mst_resp_i.aw_ready ),
215       .data_o  ( mst_req_o.aw        )
216     );
217 
218     //--------------------------------------
219     // W Channel
220     //--------------------------------------
221     // multiplexer
222     assign mst_w_chan      = (!w_fifo_empty && !b_fifo_full) ? slv_reqs_i[w_select].w        :   '0;
223     assign mst_w_valid     = (!w_fifo_empty && !b_fifo_full) ? slv_reqs_i[w_select].w_valid  : 1'b0;
224     for (genvar i = 0; i < NoSlvPorts; i++) begin : gen_slv_w_ready
225       assign slv_resps_o[i].w_ready =  mst_w_ready & ~w_fifo_empty &
226                                       ~b_fifo_full & (w_select == select_t'(i));
227     end
228     assign w_fifo_pop      = mst_w_valid & mst_w_ready;
229 
230     fifo_v3 #(
231       .FALL_THROUGH ( FallThrough ),
232       .DEPTH        ( MaxTrans    ),
233       .dtype        ( select_t    )
234     ) i_b_fifo (
235       .clk_i     ( clk_i        ),
236       .rst_ni    ( rst_ni       ),
237       .flush_i   ( 1'b0         ),
238       .testmode_i( test_i       ),
239       .full_o    ( b_fifo_full  ),
240       .empty_o   ( b_fifo_empty ),
241       .usage_o   (              ),
242       .data_i    ( w_select     ),
243       .push_i    ( w_fifo_pop   ), // push the selection for the B channel on W transaction
244       .data_o    ( b_select     ),

22 ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
23 // AXI4+ATOP Channel and Request/Response Structs
24 //
25 // Usage Example:
26 // `AXI_TYPEDEF_AW_CHAN_T(axi_aw_t, axi_addr_t, axi_id_t, axi_user_t)
27 // `AXI_TYPEDEF_W_CHAN_T(axi_w_t, axi_data_t, axi_strb_t, axi_user_t)
28 // `AXI_TYPEDEF_B_CHAN_T(axi_b_t, axi_id_t, axi_user_t)
29 // `AXI_TYPEDEF_AR_CHAN_T(axi_ar_t, axi_addr_t, axi_id_t, axi_user_t)
30 // `AXI_TYPEDEF_R_CHAN_T(axi_r_t, axi_data_t, axi_id_t, axi_user_t)
31 // `AXI_TYPEDEF_REQ_T(axi_req_t, axi_aw_t, axi_w_t, axi_ar_t)
32 // `AXI_TYPEDEF_RESP_T(axi_resp_t, axi_b_t, axi_r_t)
33 `define AXI_TYPEDEF_AW_CHAN_T(aw_chan_t, addr_t, id_t, user_t)  \
34   typedef struct packed {                                       \
35     id_t              id;                                       \
36     addr_t            addr;                                     \
37     axi_pkg::len_t    len;                                      \
38     axi_pkg::size_t   size;                                     \
39     axi_pkg::burst_t  burst;                                    \
40     logic             lock;                                     \
41     axi_pkg::cache_t  cache;                                    \
42     axi_pkg::prot_t   prot;                                     \
43     axi_pkg::qos_t    qos;                                      \
44     axi_pkg::region_t region;                                   \
45     axi_pkg::atop_t   atop;                                     \
46     user_t            user;                                     \
47   } aw_chan_t;
48 `define AXI_TYPEDEF_W_CHAN_T(w_chan_t, data_t, strb_t, user_t)  \
49   typedef struct packed {                                       \
50     data_t data;                                                \
51     strb_t strb;                                                \
52     logic  last;                                                \
53     user_t user;                                                \
54   } w_chan_t;
55 `define AXI_TYPEDEF_B_CHAN_T(b_chan_t, id_t, user_t)  \
56   typedef struct packed {                             \
57     id_t            id;                               \
58     axi_pkg::resp_t resp;                             \
59     user_t          user;                             \
60   } b_chan_t;
61 `define AXI_TYPEDEF_AR_CHAN_T(ar_chan_t, addr_t, id_t, user_t)  \
62   typedef struct packed {                                       \
63     id_t              id;                                       \
64     addr_t            addr;                                     \
65     axi_pkg::len_t    len;                                      \
66     axi_pkg::size_t   size;                                     \
67     axi_pkg::burst_t  burst;                                    \
68     logic             lock;                                     \
69     axi_pkg::cache_t  cache;                                    \
70     axi_pkg::prot_t   prot;                                     \
71     axi_pkg::qos_t    qos;                                      \
72     axi_pkg::region_t region;                                   \
73     user_t            user;                                     \
74   } ar_chan_t;
75 `define AXI_TYPEDEF_R_CHAN_T(r_chan_t, data_t, id_t, user_t)  \
76   typedef struct packed {                                     \
77     id_t            id;                                       \
78     data_t          data;                                     \
79     axi_pkg::resp_t resp;                                     \
80     logic           last;                                     \
81     user_t          user;                                     \
82   } r_chan_t;
83 `define AXI_TYPEDEF_REQ_T(req_t, aw_chan_t, w_chan_t, ar_chan_t)  \
84   typedef struct packed {                                         \
85     aw_chan_t aw;                                                 \
86     logic     aw_valid;                                           \
87     w_chan_t  w;                                                  \
88     logic     w_valid;                                            \
89     logic     b_ready;                                            \
90     ar_chan_t ar;                                                 \
91     logic     ar_valid;                                           \
92     logic     r_ready;                                            \
93   } req_t;
94 `define AXI_TYPEDEF_RESP_T(resp_t, b_chan_t, r_chan_t)  \
95   typedef struct packed {                               \
96     logic     aw_ready;                                 \
97     logic     ar_ready;                                 \
98     logic     w_ready;                                  \
99     logic     b_valid;                                  \
100     b_chan_t  b;                                        \
101     logic     r_valid;                                  \
102     r_chan_t  r;                                        \
103   } resp_t;
104 ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

107 ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
108 // All AXI4+ATOP Channels and Request/Response Structs in One Macro
109 //
110 // This can be used whenever the user is not interested in "precise" control of the naming of the
111 // individual channels.
112 //
113 // Usage Example:
114 // `AXI_TYPEDEF_ALL(axi, addr_t, id_t, data_t, strb_t, user_t)
115 //
116 // This defines `axi_req_t` and `axi_resp_t` request/response structs as well as `axi_aw_chan_t`,
117 // `axi_w_chan_t`, `axi_b_chan_t`, `axi_ar_chan_t`, and `axi_r_chan_t` channel structs.
118 `define AXI_TYPEDEF_ALL(__name, __addr_t, __id_t, __data_t, __strb_t, __user_t)                 \
119   `AXI_TYPEDEF_AW_CHAN_T(__name``_aw_chan_t, __addr_t, __id_t, __user_t)                        \
120   `AXI_TYPEDEF_W_CHAN_T(__name``_w_chan_t, __data_t, __strb_t, __user_t)                        \
121   `AXI_TYPEDEF_B_CHAN_T(__name``_b_chan_t, __id_t, __user_t)                                    \
122   `AXI_TYPEDEF_AR_CHAN_T(__name``_ar_chan_t, __addr_t, __id_t, __user_t)                        \
123   `AXI_TYPEDEF_R_CHAN_T(__name``_r_chan_t, __data_t, __id_t, __user_t)                          \
124   `AXI_TYPEDEF_REQ_T(__name``_req_t, __name``_aw_chan_t, __name``_w_chan_t, __name``_ar_chan_t) \
125   `AXI_TYPEDEF_RESP_T(__name``_resp_t, __name``_b_chan_t, __name``_r_chan_t)
126 ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
